new_en:
L (Left Stick) / R (Right Stick) | Move | Move character direction using either analog stick. | 
Cross / Square / L1 / R1 | Pick Up / Drop | Basic commands for picking up items, ingredients, and serving food. The game allows up to 4 buttons. | 
L2 / R2 | Chop / Throw | Use for chopping or slicing ingredients on the counter and throwing raw ingredients. | 
Circle / D-Pad Right | Sprint | Dash forward to increase movement speed. | 
Triangle | Emote | Open the emotion icon window to communicate. | 
Options | Pause | Pause game temporarily |
